stem: Which option is listed in the same category as chronic granulomatous disease and neutrophil adhesion disorders?
explanation: Agammaglobulinaemia immunodeficiencies is the correct category match. It appears with chronic granulomatous disease and neutrophil adhesion disorders under abnormal white cell function.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Abnormal WBC Function

optionExplanations.A: Correct because agammaglobulinaemia immunodeficiencies is grouped with chronic granulomatous disease and neutrophil adhesion disorders under abnormal white cell function.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because aplastic anaemia is a marrow failure disorder, not part of the abnormal white cell function group.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because reactive lymphadenopathy is a separate clinical finding and not listed in this category.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because monocytosis is a blood count pattern, not one of the listed white cell function disorders.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because viral neutropaenia is an acquired cause of low neutrophils rather than a functional white cell disorder.
